scientific_integrity: The all-size claim is proven analytically from Gale-Shapley proposer optimality and integer utility ratios. Separate exhaustive n=2,3 calculations and n<=14 witness checks reproduce finite claims. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Strict complete balanced lists, positive unit-spaced rank utilities, deterministic stable matchings. Claim not extended to cardinal utilities, ties, quotas or incomplete lists. Historical priority not independently established; finite verification is not the all-size proof.
title: Sharp Nash-welfare loss under proposer-optimal stable marriage
